## [TeslaMate Expenses](https://github.com/mattew124/teslamate-expenses)

Expense tracking and total cost of ownership for TeslaMate. A small web app records costs such as insurance, registration, servicing and tyres, keeps invoices, and can store them in OneDrive or in a folder on your own server. A Grafana dashboard puts those costs next to your TeslaMate drive and charge data. It keeps its data in its own `expenses` schema in the TeslaMate database and reads the TeslaMate tables directly, so it is not MQTT-based.

LINK: [github.com/mattew124/teslamate-expenses](https://github.com/mattew124/teslamate-expenses)
